category_edits.rationale: Add a fixed 0.1 residual connection from dropped input embeddings to GRU outputs at nonpadding positions before existing pooling. This may preserve recent item identity while retaining the GRU backbone, embedding design, scoring, readout, loss and optimizer. Training and inference use identical residual paths; the generated predictor already imports this model class from train.py, so no predictor or checkpoint plumbing changes are needed.
